title: Hot counter: views of a viral post
summary: A post goes viral and every viewer increments the same counter row.
background: Social apps show a view counter next to every post. The counter lives in posts.views and every view also writes an event to post_views for analytics. When a post goes viral thousands of sessions hit the same row every second.

The naive code loads the post, adds one in the application and saves views = value_loaded + 1, the pattern many ORMs produce by default. Concurrent viewers read the same value and overwrite each other, so the counter shows far fewer views than the events table recorded.

The first fix is an atomic increment: UPDATE posts SET views = views + 1. It is correct but still serializes every writer on one row lock, which caps throughput on a truly hot row. At larger scale teams shard the counter into N rows (post_id, shard) and sum them on read, or append events and aggregate them asynchronously.

race.goal: Post 1 starts with 0 views. 20 sessions view it 5 times each. posts.views must equal the 100 events recorded.

inner.title: Posts with author and tags
inner.prompt: Join posts, authors and hashtags to list every tagged post.

left.title: Posts per user, including zero
left.prompt: List every user with how many posts they wrote. Silent users must show 0.

right.title: Unused hashtags
right.prompt: List every hashtag with the posts using it, keeping hashtags no post uses.

full.title: Our hashtags versus trending
full.prompt: Match our hashtags with the external trending feed, showing tags only we have and tags only trending has.

cross.title: Daily views grid
cross.prompt: Build every post x day of the last 3 days grid and count the views in each cell, 0 when none.

self.title: Mutual follows
self.prompt: Find pairs of users who follow each other, each pair once.

semi.title: Users following a popular author
semi.prompt: Return users that follow at least one author whose post has more than 2 views events.

anti.title: Posts nobody viewed
anti.prompt: Return posts that have no view event.

lateral.title: Top post per author
lateral.prompt: For every user return their most viewed post.
